faq.question: Which PSG institution is this?
faq.answer: This is PSG College of Technology at Peelamedu, Coimbatore, affiliated to Anna University. Its TNEA code is 2006. PSG College of Arts & Science, PSG Institute of Technology and Applied Research and PSG Polytechnic have separate admissions.

faq.question: How long is engineering study?
faq.answer: The listed regular BE/BTech degrees follow a four-year structure. Mechanical Engineering Sandwich is a five-year self-financing route with morning practical training and evening classes. Do not apply the four-year format to that route.

faq.question: What subjects are required for undergraduate engineering?
faq.answer: The verified academic school route requires recognised HSC/Class 11 and 12 study with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. TNEA sets 45% general and 40% for the specified Tamil Nadu reservation categories. Separate vocational and equivalence routes need their own assessment.

faq.question: Who can use the FN/OCI route?
faq.answer: The college explicitly lists 16 regular four-year engineering programmes for foreign-national/OCIadmission. Applicants need 12 years of schooling, 45% PCM average, English medium or English as a school subject, and the scheme documents. Selection remains provisional pending the relevant authorities.

faq.question: Do those overseas approvals cover every course?
faq.answer: No. The 2026–27 approval table distinguishes regular undergraduate engineering from Mechanical Sandwich and postgraduate courses. This page restricts the latter to verified domestic routes; a general overseas-admission statement does not establish every programme’s availability.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The current college FN/OCI admission page explicitly states English as the institution’s medium of instruction. Applicants should check the selected programme’s current teaching and assessment arrangements and any separate language-entry conditions.

faq.question: When did first-year cohorts join?
faq.answer: The verified undergraduate orientation baseline is 17 August 2026. The official 2025–26 calendar separately lists first-year ME/MTech class work 21 August 2025, MCA reopening 6 August 2025 and PSGIM MBA class work 18 August 2025. These dated cohorts do not announce future availability.

faq.question: How do postgraduate qualifications differ?
faq.answer: Each engineering master’s has an exact accepted-degree and branch list. MCA has separate degree, Mathematics, marks and education-pattern conditions. The PSGIM institutional MBA route requires 60% in a recognised bachelor’s degree, while MBA Waste Management and Social Entrepreneurship requires 55%.

faq.question: Are tuition amounts confirmed?
faq.answer: Request an itemised quote for the exact degree, admission category and funding choice. General fee categories do not establish programme-specific annual tuition or the FN/OCI schedule. Separate university charges, deposits, practical training and hostel/mess costs before budgeting.

faq.question: Is the sandwich training charge included?
faq.answer: The TNEA brochure states that an additional practical-training charge applies to sandwich study and will be notified by the Principal at admission. Obtain that amount and the complete five-year academic budget before paying.

faq.question: Does a counselling call guarantee admission?
faq.answer: No. Academic eligibility, selection or ranking, original-document verification, applicable category permissions and authority confirmation remain required. Complete the exact college and admission-system steps for the selected programme.

faq.question: Is accommodation automatic?
faq.answer: Hostel accommodation requires a separate allocation process. Ask about current availability, room rules, deposits, mess costs and reporting arrangements; a course offer does not confirm a room or an individual dietary provision.
